_meta.description: Standard plant layout arrangement templates. Each template defines how equipment is positioned relative to each other. Coordinates are normalised — the engine scales them to fit the actual plot dimensions.

cascade.name: Cascade (Stepped) Layout
cascade.description: Equipment arranged in a stepped formation with natural gravity flow. Each stage higher than the next. Classic PROMAN configuration.
cascade.best_for: Sloped sites or plots where natural fall is available. Reduces conveyor lengths.
rules: VGF and JAW always at ground level
Cone elevated on platform to allow discharge belt clearance
Screen elevated so product belts run downhill to stockpile
VSI on same platform level as Cone or slightly higher
Stockpiles at far end from feed pile

linear.name: Linear Layout
linear.description: All primary equipment in a straight line from feed to product. Suitable for long, narrow plots.
linear.best_for: Long narrow sites or where access road runs along one side.
rules: Product stockpiles perpendicular to the main line
Longer conveyor runs — quote belt lengths carefully
Access road runs parallel along south side

l_shape.name: L-Shape Layout
l_shape.description: Primary crushing in one direction, secondary/tertiary at 90°. Compact and flexible.
l_shape.best_for: Square or L-shaped plots. Good when stockpile area is limited on one side.
rules: Primary section runs north-south (jaw and VGF)
Secondary/tertiary turns east-west at the screen

custom.name: Custom Layout
custom.description: User-defined arrangement. Upload a schematic or define equipment positions manually.
custom.best_for: Sites with specific constraints — existing structures, roads, utility lines.
custom.schematic_notes: Upload site plan or hand sketch to attach here
